Sub: Implementation of e-payment Modalities

This has reference to OM No.Bkg.1(25)/NEFT/Electronic Data Transfer/2087 dated
28/29.04.2010 whereby e-payment modalities for releasing payment to beneficiaries
was introduced for Unix based legacy offices.

The target date for completion of e-payment modalities was fixed as 10.05.2010

and reports submitted have been reviewed.

It is noted with deep concern that as on 11.05.2010 only 23 offices have furnished
returned MIS received from SBI. The upload report has been submitted by 31 offices
who failed to obtain returned MIS from SBI. Collectively, implementation report has
been received from 54 offices only indicating a shortfall of 40% in implementation of

e-payment modalities.

ACC(HR & RJ} and ACC(GJ & MP) have put in sincere efforts and have
achieved appreciable performance. However ACC(AP & OR), ACC(DL & UT),
ACC(KN & GOA), ACC(MH & CHH), ACC(TN & KR) and ACC(WB & NER) have not been
able to achieve 100% target.

Detailed guidelines for implementation of e-payment module have already

been circulated. The process flow at SBI for NEFT implementation has also been mailed

to all offices. Despite this, 37 offices have failed to implement the e-payment module

which is not acceptable.
It is reiterated that implementation of e-payment modalities is a high priority area

and all legacy offices should complete the implementation exercise within two days.

Any problem faced in implementation process to be resolved at Head Office level
